CALL NOTES · SETUP GUIDE

HOW TO SET IT UP

THREE STEPS
You don't need to unzip or edit anything. Upload the file as it comes. Want to see it first?
The setup video is at the bottom of this page.
DOWNLOAD THE ZIP

1

Click the download button in your email to save call-notes.zip. Leave it zipped. Claude only accepts the
zip.
TIP

On a Mac, Safari may unzip it for you and leave a call-notes folder in Downloads. Right-click the folder,

choose Compress "call-notes", and upload the new call-notes.zip. Using Chrome? It stays zipped.

UPLOAD IT TO CLAUDE

2

In Claude, go to Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill and drag the zip in. Claude shows a short
summary of what the skill does.
TIP

On a Claude Team plan? Share the skill with your organization so every rep has it.

PASTE A CALL

3

Start a new chat and paste a call transcript right after the call. Say "Turn this into call notes." Your notes
come back in seconds.
TIP

Any transcript works: Zoom, Google Meet, your dialer, or a recorder app. Paste the whole thing.

WATCH IT DONE · 3-MINUTE WALKTHROUGH

▶

Watch the setup video on YouTube
youtube.com/watch?v=LGtN2FJjV70

CALL NOTES · SETUP GUIDE

OPTIONAL · 2 MINUTES

MAKE IT YOURS
It works without this. If you want notes built around your business, open the skill, click
Edit, and find Your Business. Write your answer after each colon, delete the e.g.
examples, and save.

What you sell

Roof replacements · Fitness coaching · Payroll software · Life insurance

Who you sell to

Homeowners 50+ · Busy moms · Business owners doing $1M+ · HR managers

Your key numbers

Revenue and profit · Weight and body fat · Monthly electric bill

Problem categories

3 to 6 one-word buckets: Sales, Marketing, Operations, People

Deal breakers

What must be true to buy: Must own home · Minimum $5k budget · Must be in Texas

FASTER WAY

LET CLAUDE FILL IT IN
Upload SKILL.md to a chat and say: "Customize this for my business: I sell [X] to [Y]." Then upload the
version it gives you back.

CALL NOTES · SETUP GUIDE

ONCE IT'S RUNNING

WHAT YOU GET BACK
Every call comes back in this format. Here's an example from a B2B sales call.
EXAMPLE OUTPUT

B2B · SALES CALL

Who: Personal injury law firm, 3 attorneys
Current → Goal: 22% lead-to-client rate → 35% by Q3
Problem: Sales: Intake misses callbacks. "We pay $400 a lead and let them go to voicemail." Losing cases to
competitors.
Decision: Managing partner, other partners must approve
Objections: Authority: "Need partner buy-in first"
Extra Notes: —
Missing: none

Who

The business or the person's situation, in a few words.

Current → Goal

Where they are, where they want to be, and by when. Numbers when they gave them.

Problem

The one thing stopping them, their exact quote, and what it costs them.

Decision / Objections

Who decides, and the real objection (not just the first one they said).

Missing

What the call never covered. Ask it on the next call.

MAKE IT A HABIT

Paste the notes on the contact in your CRM after every call. Then anyone who picks up the deal sees the
whole story, and the prospect never has to repeat themselves.
